format: Text with inline TeX in $...$ and display TeX in $$...$$. Glossary symbol and units fields are TeX without delimiters.

terms.definition: Ratio of reflected to incident electric field at a boundary.
Ratio of transmitted to incident electric field at a boundary.
Fraction of incident power that reflects.
Fraction of incident power that crosses the boundary. $R+T=1$ for lossless media.
Ratio of the speed of light in vacuum to the phase velocity in the medium.
A quarter-wave layer whose impedance is the geometric mean of the media on either side, so reflections cancel.
The plane containing the incident direction and the normal to the boundary.
$\mathbf{E}$ normal to the plane of incidence. Also called TE or s-polarization.
$\mathbf{E}$ in the plane of incidence. Also called TM or p-polarization.
Incidence angle beyond which a wave going into a less dense medium is totally reflected.
Complete reflection beyond the critical angle. It guides light along optical fibres.
Incidence angle at which the parallel component is fully transmitted.
A glass core inside a cladding of slightly lower index, which guides light by total internal reflection.
